# Introduction

The {{"template":"referral","description":"an energy storing block","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is an energy storing block introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / lcc:0.3.2"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. It can output and receive {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}} to any connected {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine","plural":true}}.

# Stats

Information about a {{"of":"self"}} can be viewed by hovering over the item in an inventory, or by right clicking the placed block to open the GUI.

The {{"of":"self"}} can hold up to 40,000 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}.

The maximum amount of {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy"}} that can be inserted or extracted in a single game tick is 256 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}.

# Usage

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} are placed directionally with an output side. All other sides receive energy.

The power bank's energy can be sent and received through {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:power_cable","plural":true}} or direct connections to blocks.

# Charging

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can insert or extract energy from any {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/battery"}} placed into its GUI as an item.

# Preserving Energy

When this block is broken, the stored energy is lost. To prevent this, you can mine the block with a {{"of":"minecraft:item / minecraft:pickaxe"}} enchanted with {{"of":"minecraft:enchantment / minecraft:silk_touch"}}.

# Upgrading

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can be directly upgraded into a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:steel_power_bank"}}, a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/tier2","text":"tier 2 machine"}} with an increased storage capacity of TBD {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}. The crafting recipe for this involves {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:steel_ingot","plural":true}}, requiring other machines of at least {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/tier1","text":"tier 1"}}.

{{"of":"self","plural":true}} can also be upgraded into a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:gold_power_bank"}}, a {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/tier1.5","text":"tier 1.5 machine"}} with an increased storage capacity of 100,000 {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_base:to_energy","text":"TE"}}. This is not required to upgrade to {{"of":"to_base:tag / to_sky_and_stars:machine/tier2","text":"tier 2"}}.
